meta.title: JS Scripts — lightweight dependency-free scripts
hero.title: Lightweight dependency-free JS scripts
hero.sub: Tabs, themes, menu, copy and scroll animations. Vanilla JavaScript, ARIA, keyboard support, MIT license.
tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.desc: Panel switching with ARIA roles and Arrow, Home and End key control. Can keep the active tab in the URL hash and fires onChange. API: go(id|index), next(), prev(), active().
tabs.pa: Content of the first panel. Try the arrow keys.
theme.title: ThemeSwitcher — dark mode
theme.desc: Cycles system → light → dark. The choice is saved in localStorage, and system mode follows prefers-color-scheme. Sets data-theme on <html>. API: set(mode), get().
menu.title: HeaderMenu — mobile menu
menu.desc: Burger menu with aria-expanded. Closes on Escape, outside click and link click. Narrow the window below 700 px to see it in this page's header. API: open(), close(), toggle().
copy.title: CopyButton
copy.desc: Copies text via the Clipboard API, with a fallback for insecure contexts. Source: data-copy or data-copy-target. Sets a data-copied attribute for 1.5 seconds.
reveal.title: ScrollReveal
reveal.desc: IntersectionObserver adds the is-visible class when an element enters the viewport. Supports stagger, once and threshold, and is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
usage.title: Usage
usage.desc: Copy a file from src into your project and include it with a script tag. No bundler or dependencies needed.
soon.title: Icons via npm
soon.desc: Run npm install, then npm run icons: Font Awesome, Bootstrap Icons, Material Design Icons and Tabler fonts land in vendor/icons.
slider.title: Slider
slider.desc: Side-by-side slides with buttons, arrow keys, swipe and autoplay that pauses on hover. API: go, next, prev, stop.
gallery.title: Gallery — lightbox
gallery.desc: Click an image to open fullscreen view. Arrows navigate, Esc closes, data-full points to the original.
search.title: NativeSearch — list filter
search.desc: Instant client-side filtering of page elements by text, no server requests. The onResult callback returns the match count.
footer.title: FooterBlock
footer.desc: Fills [data-year] with the current year and adds a back-to-top button with smooth scrolling that respects prefers-reduced-motion.
accordion.title: Accordion
accordion.desc: Collapsible blocks with aria-expanded. The single option keeps only one open. API: open, closeAll.
modal.title: Modal
modal.desc: A wrapper over the native dialog: focus trap and Esc come from the browser, plus closing on backdrop click.
toast.title: Toast — notifications
toast.desc: Popup messages with success and error types, aria-live and auto-dismiss. Needs no CSS.
lazy.title: LazyLoad
lazy.desc: Loads img[data-src] when the image nears the viewport. Without IntersectionObserver it loads everything at once.
countdown.title: Countdown
countdown.desc: Timer to a date shown as days HH:MM:SS, with an onEnd callback when it finishes.
tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.desc: Tooltips from data-tip on hover and focus, with aria-describedby and screen-edge clamping.
validator.title: FormValidator
validator.desc: Built on the Constraint Validation API: aria-invalid, messages in [data-error-for], custom texts via messages, onSubmit receives the form data.
spy.title: ScrollSpy
spy.desc: Highlights the menu item whose section is on screen and sets aria-current. This page highlights the header links.
utils.title: Utils — debounce and throttle
utils.desc: Small helpers: debounce, throttle, once and ready. They cut redundant calls on input and scroll.
storage.title: SafeStorage — storage with TTL
storage.desc: A localStorage wrapper with JSON, entry expiry and an in-memory fallback when localStorage is unavailable.
cookie.title: CookieConsent — cookie banner
cookie.desc: Consent banner that remembers the choice, with custom texts and an onChange callback. API: show, get, reset.
autosize.title: AutoSize — growing textarea
autosize.desc: The field adjusts its height to the text with no scrollbar. API: update.
sorttable.title: SortTable
sorttable.desc: Sorts on header click or Enter, detects numbers automatically and sets aria-sort.
